description: Look up a single word in the Aranese dictionary: from Aranese (oc) it gives category, pronunciation, Spanish and Catalan translations, forms or conjugation and synonyms; from Spanish (es) or Catalan (ca) it gives the Aranese equivalents. Without 'lengua' it tries oc, then es, then ca.
name: diccionari_aranes
title: Diccionari aranés
